<div class="content" data-astro-cid-udnhsk2t>  <div class="c2-eyebrow-rule on-film" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><i data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu></i><span data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>MUI NE · SINCE 2007</span></div> <h1 class="c2-display h1" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>BUILT BY<br data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>THE WIND.</h1> <p class="c2-lede on-film support" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>A kite and wing centre on the beach at Mui Ne, Vietnam. We teach here, we ride here, and we have been doing both since 2007.</p> </div>  </section>  <script type="module"></script>  <section class="story" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-wrap sgrid" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="scopy" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-eyebrow-rule" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><i data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu></i><span class="c2-eyebrow" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>THE STORY</span></div> <h2 class="c2-h2 sh2" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>MUI NE.<br data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>SINCE 2007.</h2> <p class="slede" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>C2SKY was founded by Liz Kaiser and has been part of the kitesurfing scene in Mui Ne since 2007. It started as a school and it still is one: the rental and the storage exist because the people learning here needed them.</p> <p class="sbody" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Mui Ne earns its reputation in the trade-wind season, when the north-east wind runs day after day across a long, shallow beach. That is why the school is here, and it is why the year has a shape: some months you can plan a trip around, and some months we will tell you to come another time.</p> <div class="stats" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="stat" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-numeral sv" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>2007</div> <div class="sk" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Teaching in Mui Ne since</div> </div> <div class="stat" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-numeral sv" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>2</div> <div class="sk" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Riding spots: the kite beach and flat water</div> </div> <div class="stat" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-numeral sv" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>2</div> <div class="sk" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Disciplines: kitesurf and wingfoil</div> </div> </div> </div>  <div class="smedia" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <picture data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <source type="image/webp" srcset="/media/generated/human-proof-640.webp 640w, /media/generated/human-proof-960.webp 960w, /media/generated/human-proof-1400.webp 1400w, /media/generated/human-proof-1672.webp 1672w, /media/generated/human-proof-1920.webp 1920w" sizes="(max-width:1019px) 100vw, 46vw" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <img src="/media/generated/human-proof-1920.jpg" srcset="/media/generated/human-proof-640.jpg 640w, /media/generated/human-proof-960.jpg 960w, /media/generated/human-proof-1400.jpg 1400w, /media/generated/human-proof-1672.jpg 1672w, /media/generated/human-proof-1920.jpg 1920w" sizes="(max-width:1019px) 100vw, 46vw" alt="Two people standing together in waist-deep water, working through control-bar handling." loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> </picture> </div> </div> </section>  <section class="arch" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-wrap" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="head" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-eyebrow-rule" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><i data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu></i><span class="c2-eyebrow" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>WHAT C2SKY IS</span></div> <h2 class="c2-h2 ah2" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>LEARN. RIDE. STAY.</h2> </div> <p class="headnote" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Three things, in the order most people need them. Everything else on this site is one of the three with a price on it.</p> </div> <div class="rows" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <a class="arow" href="/vietnam-kitesurf-lessons/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="an" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>01</div> <div class="atitle c2-display" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>LEARN</div> <div class="abody" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <p class="aline" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Private tuition on the beach, one instructor to one rider.</p> <p class="atext" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Most people are riding on their own inside 12 hours. We teach kitesurf and wingfoil, and we will tell you which one suits the week you are here.</p> </div> <div class="acta" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <span data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Kitesurf courses</span> <svg></svg> </div> </a><a class="arow" href="/mui-ne-kitesurf-rentals/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="an" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>02</div> <div class="atitle c2-display" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>RIDE</div> <div class="abody" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <p class="aline" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Gear, storage and a camera pointed at the water.</p> <p class="atext" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Complete sets by the hour, the day or the week, storage on the same beach from €5 a day, and a live view of the spot before you leave for the beach.</p> </div> <div class="acta" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <span data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Rental rates</span> <svg></svg> </div> </a><a class="arow" href="/accommodation/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="an" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>03</div> <div class="atitle c2-display" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>STAY</div> <div class="abody" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <p class="aline" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Somewhere to sleep, sorted by people who live here.</p> <p class="atext" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>We do not run a hotel. We do know Mui Ne, and we are happy to point you at places we know ourselves — near the water, near the centre, at the kind of budget you tell us about. Send your dates and who you are travelling with.</p> </div> <div class="acta" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <span data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Ask about accommodation</span> <svg></svg> </div> </a> </div> </div> </section>  <section class="teach" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-wrap tgrid" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-eyebrow-rule on-film" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><i data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu></i><span data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>HOW WE TEACH</span></div> <h2 class="c2-h2 th2" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>PROGRESSION<br data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>BEFORE EVERYTHING.</h2> <p class="tlede" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>A kite is not difficult to fly. Doing it safely, in the right spot, on the right day, is the part that takes teaching, so that is what we sell.</p> <div class="certs" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <span class="ck" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>CERTIFIED</span> <span class="cv" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>IKO + IWO</span> </div> </div> <div class="tcells" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="tcell" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-display tt" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>ONE RIDER, ONE INSTRUCTOR</div> <p data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Courses are taught private 1:1, or 2:1 if you arrive as two. Nobody is queuing for a turn on the kite.</p> </div> <div class="tcell" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-display tt" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>THE SPOT FOLLOWS THE DAY</div> <p data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>The teaching area is chosen for the wind, the tide and what you are working on. The open beach and the flat water are different tools.</p> </div> <div class="tcell" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-display tt" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>SAFETY IS NOT A MODULE</div> <p data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Self-rescue, right of way and reading the window are taught alongside riding, not bolted on at the end of the course.</p> </div> <div class="tcell" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-display tt" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>WE WILL SAY NO</div> <p data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>If the wind is wrong for a first lesson, or you are not ready to take a set out alone, we will tell you. <a class="inl c2-inline" href="/mui-ne-webcam/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>See conditions →</a></p> </div> </div> </div> </section>  <section class="people" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="pmedia" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <picture data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <source type="image/webp" srcset="/media/generated/wingfoil-action-640.webp 640w, /media/generated/wingfoil-action-960.webp 960w, /media/generated/wingfoil-action-1400.webp 1400w" sizes="(max-width:1019px) 100vw, 50vw" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <img src="/media/generated/wingfoil-action-1400.jpg" srcset="/media/generated/wingfoil-action-640.jpg 640w, /media/generated/wingfoil-action-960.jpg 960w, /media/generated/wingfoil-action-1400.jpg 1400w" sizes="(max-width:1019px) 100vw, 50vw" alt="A wingfoiler clear of the water, board and foil lifted, wing held overhead off Mui Ne." loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> </picture> </div> <div class="pbody" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-eyebrow-rule" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><i data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu></i><span class="c2-eyebrow" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>THE PEOPLE</span></div>  <h2 class="c2-h2 ph2" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>TWO BEACHES.<br data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>ONE C2SKY.</h2>  <p class="plede" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>We teach at two spots on this coast: the kite beach in front of the centre, and Wingfoil Beach for wings and flat water, and it is the same team on both. The instructors are the people who answer the messages, arrange the transfer and decide, on the morning, which beach your session belongs on.</p> <p class="plede second" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>That is the whole method: local knowledge, one rider to one instructor, and a spot chosen for the day you are actually here.</p>  <div class="proof" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="prow" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <span class="pv" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><span class="c2-numeral" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>4.8</span> ★</span> <span class="pk" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><span class="mark" style="--mk:14px" data-astro-cid-tjrporra><svg></svg></span>Google · 295 reviews</span> </div><div class="prow" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <span class="pv" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><span class="c2-numeral" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>4.9</span> ★</span> <span class="pk" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><span class="mark" style="--mk:14px" data-astro-cid-tjrporra><svg></svg></span>TripAdvisor · 313 reviews</span> </div> </div> <p class="pnote" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Those ratings are what people wrote after riding here. We would rather point at them than write our own paragraph about ourselves.</p> </div> </section>  <section class="place" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <picture data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <source type="image/webp" srcset="/media/generated/place-turbines-640.webp 640w, /media/generated/place-turbines-960.webp 960w, /media/generated/place-turbines-1400.webp 1400w, /media/generated/place-turbines-1672.webp 1672w, /media/generated/place-turbines-1920.webp 1920w" sizes="100vw" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <img src="/media/generated/place-turbines-1920.jpg" srcset="/media/generated/place-turbines-640.jpg 640w, /media/generated/place-turbines-960.jpg 960w, /media/generated/place-turbines-1400.jpg 1400w, /media/generated/place-turbines-1672.jpg 1672w, /media/generated/place-turbines-1920.jpg 1920w" sizes="100vw" alt="A kitesurfer riding through the surf at Mui Ne, with the wind turbines on the ridge behind." loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> </picture> <div class="plcopy" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-eyebrow-rule on-film" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu><i data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu></i><span data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>THE PLACE</span></div> <h2 class="c2-display plh" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>TWO SPOTS,<br data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>ONE SEASON.</h2> <p data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>The kite beach is open coast and gets choppy exactly when it gets good. Wingfoil Beach is flat water and runs on its own seasonal window, roughly October to the end of April. We will tell you which one your week suits.</p> <a class="c2-btn c2-btn-film plcta" href="/mui-ne-webcam/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>SEE CONDITIONS</a> </div> </section>  <section class="closing" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div class="c2-wrap crow" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <div data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu> <h2 class="c2-display cheadline" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>COME RIDE<br data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>MUI NE.</h2> <p class="csupport" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>Tell us when you land and what you can already do. We will send back one plan with one number on it. <a class="inl light c2-inline" href="/prices/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>See prices →</a></p> </div> <div class="cacts" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>  <a class="c2-btn c2-btn-white tall" href="/book/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>BOOK</a> <a class="c2-btn c2-btn-film quiet" href="/mui-ne-webcam/" data-astro-cid-6ex3vpeu>SEE CONDITIONS</a> </div> </div> </section> <footer class="foot" data-astro-cid-vvk2n4iu> <div class="c2-wrap cols" data-astro-cid-vvk2n4iu> <div data-astro-cid-vvk2n4iu> <span class="c2-word on-ink word" style="--wm:46px" data-astro-cid-4sa3hazu>C<i data-astro-cid-4sa3hazu>2</i>SKY</span>  <div class="sub" data-astro-cid-vvk2n4iu>KITE &amp; WING CENTER</div> <p class="blurb" data-astro-cid-vvk2n4iu>Kitesurf and wingfoil school in Mui Ne, Vietnam. Two riding spots: the kite beach, and flat water.</p> <p class="cert" data-astro-cid-vvk2n4iu><span class="c2-mark" data-astro-cid-vvk2n4iu></span>IKO + IWO CERTIFIED SCHOOL</p> </div>  <div
